title: Amazon Basics Hypoallergenic Cotton Rounds for Makeup Removal and Skincare, 100 Count, 1 Pack

reviews.title: Soft Cotton Rounds That Work Well for Skincare
reviews.body: These cotton rounds are soft, durable, and work well for everyday skincare and makeup removal. They don’t fall apart easily when using toner or micellar water, which I appreciate. The packaging is simple and convenient, and the quantity is great for the price. Overall, a reliable product to keep on hand.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 7, 2026
reviews.author: Dahlia

reviews.title: Great Quality & Value – My Everyday Essential
reviews.body: I use these cotton rounds every single day, and they’ve become a staple in my skincare routine. They’re soft, gentle on the skin, and work perfectly for removing makeup or applying toner.The quality is excellent—they hold together well and don’t fall apart during use. For the amount you get, the price is really hard to beat, making them a great value for everyday use.I’ve been very happy with these and will continue to repurchase. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, affordable cotton rounds!They’re gentle enough for sensitive skin and work great for all my skincare steps.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 29, 2026
reviews.author: Pamela F Kudna

reviews.title: Good quality but slightly loose cotton
reviews.body: This product is great for removing eye makeup and absorbs micellar water well. The cotton round is thick and just the right size for both eyes. However, the cotton sometimes comes undone when my hangnails get stuck on it. It's also easy to tear apart if you pull on it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 3, 2026
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.title: Excellent Quality and Good Value
reviews.body: While these really don't cost any or much less than the grocery store pads, I do find that they have good cotton content, are exceedingly soft, remove makeup often with one swipe, shed very little if at all, and are quite versatile. I've bought them three times and plan to keep it up.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 3, 2026
reviews.author: Kelley R.

reviews.title: Last a while
reviews.body: Work well and have lasted me more than six months. They do get pulled apart easily so sometimes wiping your face leaves the cotton fuzzies

reviews.title: Good Buy
reviews.body: These seem to be pretty good especially for the price.  I use mascara that’s pretty tough to remove, these cotton rounds help along with makeup remover without coming apart.  They are soft and are lint free. They also absorb very well.

reviews.title: Great for Skin
reviews.body: These Amazon Basics Hypoallergenic 100% Cotton Rounds for Makeup Remover and Skincare are honestly a great find. They’re super soft—so they feel nice on your skin—and they’re tough enough not to fall apart when you use them. Plus, you get a lot for a really good price. If you need something simple that just works for cleaning your face or taking off makeup, these cotton rounds do the job without any fuss.
